title: The draw lands: Paris, Manchester, and no early Clasico
deck: Friday’s brief before the Athletic home game.

stories.headline: UCL league phase: PSG away and City at home
stories.summary: The draw gave Barcelona two of the loudest nights in the competition before Christmas. Flick wanted a calendar he could rotate through. He did not get a gentle one.

tweets.name: Barca Universal
tweets.text: PSG away. City at home. Write those two dates in ink.

stories.headline: Athletic at home, with Rodri in line for minutes
stories.summary: Flick was expected to hand Rodri his first Camp Nou minutes off the bench and keep the spine that beat Elche.

tweets.name: Tarrega Blaugrana
tweets.text: Predicted XI circulating. Rotation expected, standards not.

stories.headline: Alvarez trail goes cold again
stories.summary: Atletico repeated that they do not negotiate with Barcelona for Julian Alvarez. Unless a structure changes in September, Flick plans with the forwards he has.

tweets.name: Fabrizio Romano
tweets.text: Same story tonight: Atletico will not open Alvarez talks with Barca.

stories.headline: Four summer signings all registered
stories.summary: Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo are all on the list. Registration gymnastics that used to leak into September were finished this time.

tweets.name: Barca Times
tweets.text: All four registered. No late paperwork panic. Rare, and welcome.
